title: Saray akaamot a dumerengel ya anisia
intro: Diad kareenan na sakey a sagradon pantitipon, sinmabi so sakey a makapadinayew a pantitipon a nanlapud agnanengneng a pasen. Lapud saray bulong na sakey a makapakelkelaw, dinmengel ira ed panagbalikas ya mamatunda ed kapalaran da ed andi-anggaan. Say testimonya ra et sakey ed saray sankatalonggaringan ed madibinon kasulatan.
clues: Sikami so pinalsa a nanlapud sakey a pasen ya ag anengneng na karaklan, tan linma kami bilang sakey a grupo.
Linma kami ed sakey a pantitipon pian narengel so sakey a makapadinayew.
Nen sinmabi kami diman, dinmengel kami na sakey a panangibalikas ya amabigla ed sikami.
Maparungtal min binidbir ya arum ed limog mi et matunong tan arum et andi.
Amta min ag kami makaliktar ed madibinon ganggan diad dalin, odino diad itakas mi ed tawen.
Nen nadngel mi so panangigiya, anisia kami ed satan; siopaman a manisia ed Katawan to et ag ontakot ed pakaandi odino pabelat.

identity.label: Siopa ak?
options: Sakey a grupo na Jinn
Saray totoo ed Iram
Saray Totoo ed Tubba'
Say Empiryo na Roma

options: Pandengel ed sakey a sagradon panangibalikas
Manpapaalagey na atagey iran lusek ed syudad tayo
Manaanap na makapadinayew a kabatyan a kamelyo

trial.answer: Pandengel ed sakey a sagradon panangibalikas

location.label: Manunan Elemento
options: Sakey a pantitipon na sagradon panagbalikas
Sakey a syudad na atagey iran lusek (Iram)
Sakey a bobon ed desierto
Sakey a baleg a palasyo a balitok
Sakey a sagradon ungib ed kapalandeyan
location.answer: Sakey a pantitipon na sagradon panagbalikas

outcome.label: Pansumpalan
options: Anisia kami tan pinasakbayan mi ray totoo mi
Naderal lapud maksil ya sabog manlapud tawen
Dusaen na mansasnit tan makaderal a dagem
Niiter so baleg a kayamanan tan pakayari
Nansiansian agmakapanisia
outcome.answer: Anisia kami tan pinasakbayan mi ray totoo mi

arabic: وَأَنَّا مِنَّا ٱلصَّـٰلِحُونَ وَمِنَّا دُونَ ذَٰلِكَ ۖ كُنَّا طَرَآئِقَ قِدَدًۭا
verse: And among us are the righteous, and among us are [others] not so; we were [of] divided ways. (72:11)
